name: Iran nuclear programme
value: Iran proposal via Qatar; strike threats
summary: Iran sends a nuclear proposal via Qatar on 5 Nov as Trump weighs resuming strikes; no IAEA access
state: Iran sent a formal nuclear and peace proposal to the US through Qatar on 5 Nov, conditioning talks on seven demands including an end to sanctions and the naval blockade (Fox News; Just Security). President Trump said he would decide soon on resuming military action and questioned whether more strikes were needed against the nuclear programme (Khaleej Times). The IAEA still lacks access to key sites; no strike on a nuclear facility was reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf. Renewed strikes would raise risks to regional travel and shipping.
rubric_hit: Watch: inspector access curtailed and credible strike threats; no strike on nuclear sites

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.

rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
